notes.title: Dungeonpunk Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Developer Brendan here, and today I'm here to show you the current development progress on the winner of the character poll, Dungeonpunk!

Within these past few weeks, we've been hard at work at making our new wizard friend come to life. While we don't have anything final to show to you today, we do have some art and basic ability functionality that could give you a pretty good idea of where we plan on taking Dungeonpunk. Please note that as always, nothing here is final and is subject to change before release.

Who is Dungeonpunk?

Dungeonpunk (or, as his disciples call him, Ocatrine) is an absolutely yoked magic user who laughs at the notion that wizards are all old and frail. Being a practitioner of the arcane arts, he is naturally inclined to use magic and regenerating mana instead of guns and ammunition. His abilities work as follows:

Weapon - Prism Bazooka
This weapon fires fire ball projectiles. The projectiles can be charged to enable explosive effects.

Ability 1 - Unearthed Ice
Octarine punches a prism shooting ice projectiles around him. The ice projectiles freeze the ground it moves over causing players to slide. This ability can be charged for a longer-lasting projectile.

Ability 2 - Thunder Clap
Octarine charges electricity in his hand. Depending on how long the charge is held, different effects take place, ranging from a weak lighting projectile to a beam of mass destruction.

Dodge - Teleport
Octarine can teleport in the direction he is moving.

Let us know what you think!

Did you know that we have a Discord server? We post all of our development updates there as well, so feel free to stop by, say hello, and let us know what you think of Dungeonpunk so far!

Discord: https://discord.gg/qvKYBZKUCP

 With that, have a good weekend and happy Sniping!
